page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-16-lssd is an arm64-based server instance featuring 16 dedicated virtual CPUs and 128 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core, positioning it within the memory-optimized category for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources.

The instance includes 1611 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across four local SSD drives. This storage is bundled directly with the instance, offering high-speed local read and write capabilities. The underlying processor architecture is arm64, which offers a distinct instruction set and resource profile compared to traditional x86 architectures. No graphics processing units are included in this configuration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the arm64 architecture combined with a high-density memory allocation and integrated local NVMe storage provides a balanced resource profile for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads without the overhead of external storage attachments. This server is suited for database hosting, memory-intensive data processing, and caching layers that benefit from both high memory capacity and fast local temporary storage.
